name: Strategic Planning Session
description: Capture credit union strategic planning sessions including environmental scans, goal setting, initiative prioritization, and multi-year planning discussions.

sections.title: Session Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the purpose and scope of the planning session — whether it is an annual strategic plan, a multi-year roadmap, a retreat, or a focused strategy workshop — and the planning horizon being addressed.

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: List all attendees including board members, leadership team, facilitators, and any external consultants or guests.

sections.title: Mission, Vision & Values Review
sections.instruction: Summarize any discussion or updates to the organization's mission, vision, or core values. Note if changes were proposed or reaffirmed.

sections.title: Environmental Scan & Key Trends
sections.instruction: Capture the key external and internal factors discussed — economic conditions, competitive landscape, regulatory environment, member trends, technology changes, or workforce challenges.

sections.title: SWOT / Assessment Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats identified during any assessment exercise conducted during the session.

sections.title: Strategic Goals & Priorities
sections.instruction: List the strategic goals, pillars, or priorities established for the planning period. Include any associated metrics, targets, or success criteria discussed.

sections.title: Key Initiatives & Projects
sections.instruction: List the major initiatives, projects, or programs identified to achieve the strategic goals. Include sponsorship and priority level where discussed.

sections.title: Resource & Capacity Considerations
sections.instruction: Summarize discussions about budget, staffing, technology, or other resource constraints and how they affect plan feasibility.

sections.title: Decisions Made
sections.instruction: List key decisions reached during the session including approved goals, deprioritized initiatives, or strategic pivots agreed upon.

sections.title: Next Steps & Accountability
sections.instruction: List follow-up actions to finalize the plan — drafts to prepare, approvals needed, communication plans, and implementation milestones. Include owners and deadlines.
